##### Project general facts

Norah Residence by Al Tareq Star is a contemporary residential building designed by NAGA Architects with a people-first approach. A clean architectural style and an elegant facade defined by crisp geometric lines give the building a calm, modern character. It rises above a ground floor and a four-level podium to twelve residential floors, and offers studios, one-bedroom apartments, two-bedroom apartments with a study, and two- and three-bedroom duplexes, all equipped with smart home technology.

Amenities are chosen to make each day easier and more connected. Residents can enjoy a swimming pool, a fully equipped gym and a yoga area, together with an outdoor theatre for relaxed evenings. Families benefit from a kids' play area, while a barbecue area, a rooftop juice bar and a cafe create inviting spaces for gatherings. Retail units within the building place everyday essentials such as groceries and a pharmacy within easy reach.

Interiors combine practical functionality with a warm atmosphere and stylish details. Layouts are intuitive, lighting is soft and inviting, and high-quality materials are used throughout. Kitchens are fully equipped with appliances, and smart home systems provide added comfort and control. Selected homes enjoy calming views of the pool and the surrounding greenery. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle is a master-planned community at the heart of new Dubai, known for its circular layout, tree-lined streets and numerous parks. The southern part of the community is home to Halfa Park and the FIVE Jumeirah Village hotel, alongside vibrant retail options, while Circle Mall serves as the community's main hub for shopping, dining and entertainment for residents.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Hessa Street and Al Khail Road connect the community with Dubai Marina, Mall of the Emirates and Downtown Dubai. A nearby bus station adds public transport options for residents. Schools, nurseries, clinics and supermarkets are spread across the community and in neighbouring districts, while walking paths and landscaped parks encourage an active outdoor lifestyle close to home.

Jumeirah Village Circle is a freehold community and one of Dubai's most actively traded residential areas. Strong demand from young professionals and families supports high rental yields and steady occupancy. A central position, mature infrastructure and a wide choice of homes keep the area popular with both investors and end users seeking accessible entry points within a well-connected part of the city.
